{{Top|leg}}
'''Seeing without looking''' was one of the many survelliance skills that was taught to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. The idea behind it was to acquire knowledge about one's surroundings without allowing observers to notice that one was actually doing it. Thus, a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] could appear to be taking a simple walk down a street, but their senses were busy gathering in details and facts about the people and locations they saw.
